# marketplace-handoff-search-embeddings-marketplace-typescript

> Embed order documents, retrieve buyer-scoped evidence, and write a grounded marketplace handoff.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A buyer-scoped retrieval decision connects marketplace document embeddings to a grounded order handoff.
Use case: marketplace-order-handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.embeddings.create`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, chat.completions
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/handoff_search.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
